title: copy_modality_slots
description:
Copy items (.obs, .var, .layers, .obsm, .varm, .obsp, .varp, .uns) from a
modality in a source MuData file into a modality in the input MuData file.

By default the source and input modalities must have identical .obs and
.var index sets (ordering may differ; source is reindexed to match the
input). With --allow_partial, the source's .obs/.var indices may be a
strict subset of the input's; rows or columns of the input that are not
represented in the source are filled with NaN for numeric slots and with
the appropriate missing-value sentinel for DataFrame columns.

Existing keys in the input are not overwritten by default. Use
--allow_overwrite to allow overwriting (a warning is emitted for each
overwritten key).

Each slot argument restricts the copy to the named items. If a slot
argument is not specified, every item present in the source modality but
missing from the input modality is copied for that slot.

Dataset input.title: Dataset input
Dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple         parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml                 blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Arguments related to the input dataset, which is copied into.

input.description: The input data to copy slots into

modality.description: Which modality to copy slots into.

output.description: Output h5mu file (the input with slots copied from the source).
output.help_text: Type: `file`, multiple: `False`, required, default: `"$id.$key.output.h5mu"`, direction: `output`, example: `"output.h5mu"`.

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

source.title: Source
source.description: Arguments related to the source dataset, which is copied from.
The source data to copy slots from

source_modality.description: Which modality in the source data to copy slots from

source_var_gene_names.description:
The name of the .var column in the source data containing gene names
to match against the input .var index; when not provided, the source
.var index is used

slots to copy.title: Slots to copy
slots to copy.description:
Items to copy from the source modality into the input modality. Each
argument restricts the copy to the named items. If an argument is not
specified, every item present in the source modality but missing from
the input modality is copied for that slot.

allow_partial.description:
Allow the source's .obs/.var indices to be a strict subset of the
input's

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
